mcq.q: Fill the blank: 我们切____。 (We cut the cake.)
mcq.explanation: 蛋糕 is cake.

mcq.q: Which Chinese word means "happy"?
mcq.explanation: 快乐 (kuàilè) means happy.

mcq.q: What does 上面 (shàngmiàn) mean?
mcq.explanation: 上面 (shàngmiàn) means above.

mcq.q: What does 星期一 (xīngqīyī) mean?
mcq.explanation: 星期一 (xīngqīyī) means Monday.

mcq.q: Which Chinese word means "rain"?
mcq.explanation: 雨 (yǔ) means rain.

mcq.q: Fill the blank: 这是____妈妈。 (This is my mum.)
mcq.explanation: 我 means my.

mcq.q: What does 芒果 (mángguǒ) mean?
mcq.explanation: 芒果 (mángguǒ) means mango.

mcq.q: In the text 今天是我的生日。朋友们来我家。我很高兴。 what is the main idea?
mcq.explanation: The text is about a birthday, friends coming and being happy.

mcq.q: What does 眼睛 (yǎnjing) mean?
mcq.explanation: 眼睛 (yǎnjing) means eye.

mcq.q: Which Chinese word means "left side"?
mcq.explanation: 左边 (zuǒbian) means left side.

mcq.q: What does 我喜欢吃香蕉 mean?
mcq.explanation: 喜欢 is like, 吃 is eat and 香蕉 is banana.

mcq.q: Which sentence means "The wind is very light."?
mcq.explanation: 风很小。 (fēng hěn xiǎo.) means "The wind is very light.".

mcq.q: Fill the blank: 厨房里有____。 (There is a fridge in the kitchen.)
mcq.explanation: The fridge is in the kitchen.

mcq.q: Which Chinese word means "knee"?
mcq.explanation: 膝盖 (xīgài) means knee.

mcq.q: Which greeting is the polite way to say hello to a teacher?
mcq.explanation: 您 is the polite form of you.

mcq.q: Read the pinyin: fēng hěn dà. What does it mean?
mcq.explanation: fēng hěn dà. is 风很大。, which means "The wind is very strong.".

mcq.q: Which stroke goes from left to right?
mcq.explanation: 横 is the horizontal stroke.

mcq.q: Which sentence means "Where is the television?"?
mcq.explanation: 电视在哪儿? (diànshì zài nǎr?) means "Where is the television?".

mcq.q: In the Chinese week, which day is 星期一?
mcq.explanation: Chinese counts the days from Monday.

mcq.q: What does 有 (yǒu) mean?
mcq.explanation: 有 (yǒu) means to have, there is.

mcq.q: How many strokes does 雨 have?
mcq.explanation: 雨 has eight strokes.

mcq.q: Fill in the blank: 浴室在花园____。 (beside)
mcq.explanation: 旁边 is beside.

mcq.q: What does 我家有五口人 mean?
options: There are five people in my family
mcq.explanation: 五口人 is five people.

mcq.q: What does 哭 (kū) mean?
mcq.explanation: 哭 (kū) means to cry.

mcq.q: Which sentence means "This is my older sister."?
mcq.explanation: 这是我姐姐。 (zhè shì wǒ jiějie.) means "This is my older sister.".

mcq.q: What does 今天天气很好 mean?
options: The weather is very good today
mcq.explanation: 天气 is weather and 很好 is very good.

mcq.q: What does 小 (xiǎo) mean?
mcq.explanation: 小 (xiǎo) means small.

mcq.q: Fill the blank: 电视在桌子____。 (The television is on the table.)
mcq.explanation: 上 means on.

mcq.q: Which Chinese word means "toilet"?
mcq.explanation: 厕所 (cèsuǒ) means toilet.

mcq.q: Which word means "left side"?
mcq.explanation: 左边 is the left side.

mcq.q: What does 厕所 (cèsuǒ) mean?
mcq.explanation: 厕所 (cèsuǒ) means toilet.

mcq.q: What does 教堂 jiàotáng mean?
mcq.explanation: 教堂 is a church.

mcq.q: Why should we listen kindly when friends explain how they celebrate?
options: Families celebrate in different ways and all are meaningful
mcq.explanation: Respect for different ways of celebrating is important.

mcq.q: How many strokes does 手 have?
mcq.explanation: 撇, 横, 横, 竖钩.

mcq.q: Which day is 星期四?
mcq.explanation: 四 is four, so 星期四 is week four, Thursday.

mcq.q: What should a group do first when planning a showcase?
options: Choose an item and make a plan
mcq.explanation: A plan says who does what.

mcq.q: What does 干旱 (gānhàn) mean?
mcq.explanation: 干旱 (gānhàn) means drought.

mcq.q: Which two words share the final -ang?
options: 好 hǎo and 老 lǎo
房 fáng and 旁 páng
小 xiǎo and 早 zǎo
门 mén and 手 shǒu
mcq.explanation: fáng and páng both end in ang.

mcq.q: What does 上 (shàng) mean?
mcq.explanation: 上 (shàng) means on.

mcq.q: Which sentence is a correct answer to 这是谁?
mcq.explanation: 谁 asks who, and the answer names a person.

mcq.q: What does 没有 (méiyǒu) mean?
mcq.explanation: 没有 (méiyǒu) means there is not.

mcq.q: Fill the blank: 星期一,星期二,星期____。 (Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday)
mcq.explanation: The next day after Tuesday is Wednesday, 星期三.

mcq.q: Which word is pronounced wǎnfàn?
mcq.explanation: 晚饭 is pronounced wǎnfàn and means dinner.

mcq.q: Which verb goes with 米饭?
mcq.explanation: We eat rice, so we use 吃.

mcq.q: Which sentence means "The garden is on the right of the house."?
mcq.explanation: 花园在房子右边。 (huāyuán zài fángzi yòubian.) means "The garden is on the right of the house.".

mcq.q: What does 是 (shì) mean?
mcq.explanation: 是 (shì) means is, am, are.

mcq.q: In 十, which stroke is written first?
mcq.explanation: Horizontal comes before vertical when they cross.

mcq.q: What does 六 (liù) mean?
mcq.explanation: 六 (liù) means six.

mcq.q: What does 花园 (huāyuán) mean?
mcq.explanation: 花园 (huāyuán) means garden.

mcq.q: In 我星期三去学校, what does 星期三 tell us?
mcq.explanation: It is the time word.

mcq.q: In the syllable jiào, what is the initial?
mcq.explanation: j is the initial. iao is the final.

mcq.q: Which sentence means "For breakfast I eat bǐng."?
mcq.explanation: 我早饭吃饼。 (wǒ zǎofàn chī bǐng.) means "For breakfast I eat bǐng.".

mcq.q: Read the pinyin: chuáng zài wòshì. What does it mean?
options: The garden is on the right of the house.
The bathroom is beside the garden.
The bed is in the bedroom.
mcq.explanation: chuáng zài wòshì. is 床在卧室。, which means "The bed is in the bedroom.".

mcq.q: What does 天 (tiān) mean?
mcq.explanation: 天 (tiān) means sky, day.

mcq.q: Read the pinyin: zhè shì wǒ jiějie. What does it mean?
mcq.explanation: zhè shì wǒ jiějie. is 这是我姐姐。, which means "This is my older sister.".

mcq.q: What does 同学们 (tóngxuémen) mean?
mcq.explanation: 同学们 (tóngxuémen) means classmates.

mcq.q: How many rooms are named in 我家有客厅、卧室和厨房?
mcq.explanation: The rooms are the living room, the bedroom and the kitchen.
